plan.reason: With only 24 of 100 evaluations used and 12 stagnant steps at zero recent improvement, the optimizer needs more exploration while remaining sample-efficient. Auto surrogate lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic given the 10-D space and small dataset. current_to_best balances convergence toward the incumbent with diversity in DE. Moderate mutation (0.7) and high crossover (0.9) give good mixing; exploration 0.45 adds novelty pressure to escape stagnation; local_fraction 0.25 with radius 0.15 focuses some effort near promising regions. Population 30 and 8 generations keep candidate generation cheap relative to remaining budget without overspending.
